title: Firmware extraction (binwalk/entropy)
preconditions: artifact is a copy, not a live device
steps: `file`, `binwalk firmware.bin`, and `binwalk -E` entropy to find compressed/encrypted regions.
`binwalk -e --run-as=root firmware.bin` (in a sandbox) to carve; inspect offsets with `dd`/`xxd` if extraction fails.
Mount/extract squashfs/cramfs/jffs2, then grep `/etc/init.d`, `rcS`, web roots, and shadow/passwd for credentials.
Check update signatures/keys and hardcoded URLs; if a device is in scope, confirm UART/JTAG access rules before touching hardware.
falsifier: Entropy is uniform and no filesystem/update format is recognized; the blob may be encrypted or truncated.
pitfalls: running extraction as root on host
